annotations.title: Get published prices and cost statistics

description: Published AtlantFlow prices (diagnostic, emergency call fee, tune-up, maintenance plan, financing) plus historical invoice statistics by job type (median and middle-half range, number of jobs). Only groups with 20+ jobs are published; no per-city prices. Statistics describe past invoices, not a quote.

service.description: Optional keyword to filter historical job statistics, e.g. 'replacement', 'leak', 'drain', 'thermostat', 'capacitor'. Omit to list everything.
